high.title: Fullstack Developer
high.description:
Job Description

We are looking for a Full-stack Developer with hands-on experience building applications in the financial trading or capital markets domain. You will work across the full stack, designing and building responsive React frontends and high-performance Node.js backends while understanding the unique demands of trading platforms: real-time data streams, low-latency UI updates, order management workflows, and financial data integrity. This is not a generic web development role. You will be building systems where milliseconds matter, data accuracy is non-negotiable, and user trust is earned through reliability. If you've built trading dashboards, order books, portfolio trackers, or market data feeds, we want to talk to you. The core responsibilities for the job include the following: Frontend React: - Build and maintain high-performance, real-time trading UIs using React, TypeScript, and modern state management libraries (Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or Recoil). - Implement live data visualization components like candlestick charts, order books, P& L dashboards, and position trackers using TradingView Lightweight Charts, Recharts, or D3.js . - Consume and render WebSocket streams for real-time price feeds, order status updates, and market depth without UI lag or memory leaks. - Design responsive, accessible interfaces optimized for both desktop trading workstations and mobile monitoring views. - Write unit and integration tests using Jest and React Testing Library; maintain high test coverage for critical trading flows. Backend Node.js - Design and develop RESTful and WebSocket APIs using Node.js (Express or Fastify) to serve trading data, order management, and user portfolio operations. - Integrate with exchange APIs, market data providers (Bloomberg, Refinitiv, or equivalent), and internal pricing engines handling rate limits, reconnection logic, and data normalization. - Implement order lifecycle management: placement, modification, cancellation, execution reporting, and reconciliation workflows. - Build data pipelines for ingesting, transforming, and persisting tick data, OHLCV bars, and trade history at scale. - Ensure API security: JWT authentication, role-based access control, input validation, and audit logging for all trading operations. Architecture and Performance: - Optimize end-to-end latency across the full-stack profiling of React renders, Node.js event loop bottlenecks, and database query performance. - Implement caching strategies (Redis) for frequently accessed market data, user session state, and reference data. - Design for resilience: circuit breakers, graceful degradation, and fallback states for when market data feeds or exchange connections drop. - Participate in system design reviews and contribute to architectural decisions with clear documentation. Collaboration and Quality: - Work closely with quant analysts, trading desk stakeholders, and product managers to translate business requirements into precise technical specifications - Conduct and receive code reviews with a focus on correctness, performance, and maintainability, especially for financial calculation logic - Support QA with test scenario design for edge cases: market open/close, circuit breakers, partial fills, and rejection handling - Participate in on-call rotations and respond to production incidents with urgency during market hours Requirements: - 3-5 years of full-stack development experience with React and Node.js in production environments. - Demonstrable experience building or maintaining applications in financial trading, capital markets, fintech, or investment management. - Strong TypeScript proficiency across both frontend and backend codebases. - Solid understanding of WebSocket protocols and real-time data handling: you've built something that updates live without polling. - Experience with REST API design and integration with third-party financial data or exchange APIs. - Familiarity with financial domain concepts: order types, order book mechanics, P& L calculation, position management, and trade lifecycle. - Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL and MongoDB or Redis). - Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud deployment (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Preferred Qualifications: - Experience integrating with FIX protocol, broker APIs (Interactive Brokers, Alpaca, and Zerodha Kite), or exchange connectivity layers. - Familiarity with the TradingView Charting Library or Lightweight Charts for professional-grade market data visualizations. - Knowledge of message queues and event-driven architecture (Kafka, RabbitMQ) for high-throughput trade event processing. - Exposure to algorithmic trading systems, backtesting frameworks, or quantitative finance tooling. - Understanding of regulatory requirements: MiFID II, SEBI guidelines, or exchange compliance rules. - Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog). Technical Skills Snapshot - Frontend: React, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit / Zustand, WebSockets, D3.js / Recharts. - Backend: Node.js, Express/Fastify, REST APIs, WebSocket Server, JWT Auth. - Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis (caching and pub/sub). - Trading Domain: Order Management, Market Data Feeds, FIX Protocol, Exchange APIs. - DevOps and Cloud: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS / GCP, GitHub Actions / Jenkins. - Testing: Jest, React Testing Library, Postman / Newman, k6 (load testing). - Monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK Stack. Key Competencies: - Precision under pressure: financial systems demand correctness above all; you never cut corners on data integrity. - Real-time systems thinking: you understand event loops, memory management, and rendering pipelines at 50 updates per second. - Domain fluency: you speak the language of trading desks, not just engineering standups. - Ownership: When the market opens, your system needs to work; you take that personally. - Collaborative rigor: honest, specific code review feedback given and received. - Continuous learning: financial markets evolve, regulations change, and new asset classes emerge; you stay current. Company Summary At Zzazz, we're building the first Large Pricing Model (LPM), a revolutionary system that quantifies the real-time value and price of digital content, transforming it into a new class of dynamic asset. Unlike LLMs, which generate content based on input, our system generates real-time value and price based on multiple factors, including user decision-making behavior, market dynamics, quality, timing, contextual impact, and other critical attributes. Our advanced Economic AI learns, adapts, and evolves the perceived worth of each piece of content, assigning it a dynamic market value. We're shaping a global economy where every piece of content impacts and matters. Zzazz is building the foundation for the future of the information economy. We believe that digital content deserves more than arbitrary monetization models and opaque metrics. By assigning transparent, real-time value to the world's data and insights, we empower everyone, from the casual user who sees the price and understands its worth to creators, consumers, advertisers, and businesses, to engage in a more equitable and meaningful exchange. Our mission centers on trust, innovation, and inclusivity. We bring together a diverse team of thinkers, builders, and problem-solvers passionate about shaping a fairer digital marketplace, one that respects the complexity and worth of information and the people who produce it. Why Join Us You're not just looking for a job; you want to make an impact. You thrive in environments that challenge the status quo, you believe in bold ideas, and you want to be at the forefront of technological innovation. If you're ready to take on big challenges and shape the future of digital content with AI, then Zzazz is where you belong. At Zzazz, we move fast and push boundaries. We work hard, and we're here to get things done. Our benefits are designed to fuel your drive and ambition, giving you the support and resources needed to perform at your best!

medium.title: SDE I Backend Engineer
medium.description:
Backend Engineer (SDE 1)


About Astra


Astra is a cybersecurity SaaS company that makes otherwise chaotic pentests a breeze with its one-of-a-kind Pentest Platform. Astra's continuous vulnerability scanner emulates hacker behavior to scan applications for 9,300+ security tests. CTOs & CISOs love Astra because it helps them fix vulnerabilities in record time and move from DevOps to DevSecOps with Astra's CI/CD integrations.
Astra is loved by 650+ companies across the globe. In 2023, Astra uncovered 2 million+ vulnerabilities for its customers, saving customers $69M+ in potential losses due to security vulnerabilities.
We've been awarded by the President of France, Mr. François Hollande, at the La French Tech program and the Prime Minister of India, Shri Narendra Modi, at the Global Conference on Cyber Security. Loom, MamaEarth, Muthoot Finance, Canara Robeco, ScripBox, etc. are a few of Astra's customers.
Role Overview
At Astra Security, we are building the future of AI-driven cybersecurity, including Autonomous Pentesting — an experience that helps teams automatically discover, test, and secure Web & Mobile applications, Cloud, and APIs at scale.


As a Backend Engineer (SDE 1), you will work on building and improving the backend systems that power Astra's cybersecurity platform. You'll develop APIs, backend services, database components, and asynchronous workflows that support our core product.
You'll work closely with experienced backend engineers, frontend engineers, product managers, DevOps, and QA to build reliable and scalable features. You'll get hands-on experience taking features from development to production, debugging real-world issues, and learning how distributed backend systems are designed and operated at scale.
This is an opportunity to work on challenging engineering problems, contribute to 0-1 product initiatives, and grow your backend engineering skills in a fast-paced product environment.


Here's what's in it for you

- Build and maintain backend services and RESTful APIs for Astra's platform.
- Develop clean, maintainable, and reusable code following sound software engineering principles.
- Work with databases to design tables, write queries, and improve application performance.
- Build and work with asynchronous workflows using queues, events, and background processing.
- Debug production and development issues and identify the root cause of problems.
- Write unit and integration tests to ensure reliability and code quality.
- Work with AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity while reviewing and validating generated code before it reaches production.
- Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to continuously improve your engineering practices.
- Collaborate with frontend, product, DevOps, and QA teams to deliver features.
- Contribute to improving system reliability, developer productivity, and engineering processes.
- Learn and work with modern backend and distributed-system technologies.


What we're looking for

- 1- 3 years of experience building backend applications in a product-based or SaaS environment.
- Strong proficiency in at least one backend programming language such as Java, Python, PHP, or C++.
- Good understanding of OOP, data structures, algorithms, and core software engineering principles.
- Experience building or working with RESTful APIs.
- Good understanding of relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
- Ability to write efficient SQL queries and understand basic database design.
- Basic understanding of asynchronous processing, queues, events, or background jobs.
- Familiarity with concepts such as ORMs, dependency injection, data validation, caching, logging, and error handling.
- Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
- Good understanding of writing maintainable, testable code.
- Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS is a plus.
- Experience using AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar tools is a plus.
- Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
- A strong learning mindset and willingness to take ownership of problems.


Why Astra?

- Opportunity to work on products that solve challenging real-world cybersecurity problems.
- Work on backend systems powering an AI-driven cybersecurity platform.
- Learn from experienced engineers and work closely with founders and product teams.
- Exposure to distributed systems, asynchronous processing, cloud infrastructure, and modern backend architecture.
- Ownership of features from development through production, with the right level of guidance and mentorship.
- Fast release cycles with the ability to ship code frequently.
- Collaborative engineering culture with a strong focus on learning and innovation.
- Join a team of builders and problem-solvers who thrive on first-principles thinking, move fast without breaking trust, and take pride in shipping products that matter.
- Opportunity to contribute to products from the ground up and grow rapidly as an engineer.
- Flexible hybrid work environment.
- Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family.
- Annual team off-sites and regular team events.
- A supportive, high-growth environment where your ideas and contributions can have a real impact.
Location
This is a hybrid role in Bengaluru and requires a regular in-office presence to collaborate closely with Engineering and Product teams. Being in-office helps foster deep collaboration, faster decision-making, and the shared energy of building together — values that define how we operate at Astra.
Location: Bengaluru, India

WHO WE ARE


Genesis transforms application development in financial markets by offering a low-code platform that supercharges developers and enables organizations to build performant, secure applications with unmatched speed, efficiency, and scale.


We have the vigor and passion of a startup and the skill and experience of a scale-up, consistently refining and exploring ways to make work better for everyone.


To help us achieve our vision of reinventing the way financial market organizations build software, we are looking for people who aren’t afraid to challenge the status quo - people who are passionate about change.


If you are a self-starter with a solution-orientated mindset, you’ll find a home at Genesis.


WHAT YOU NEED & THE HATS YOU WILL WEAR


You will be an experienced Java Backend/ Full Stack Developer to join our Bangalore Team. Because the Genesis Low Code Platform brings together the best of high-performance back end and web technologies to deliver 80% reductions in time to market for development teams you will need to be experienced enough to help design and build applications and solutions using the Genesis Platform.




WHERE WE SEE THIS ROLE GOING
• While we see this role as a Java expert who will design, implement, test and maintain products built using Genesis Framework, we are also looking for someone who has a clear willingness to be adaptable and flex to new ways of working as this will be critical to remain agile and innovative
• You will be a strong collaborator and as you work through the full life cycle of software development working closely with product owners, UI/UX developers, and core engineers in an iterative process. This will allow you to build knowledge of our business, services, and client needs
• As we work to tight deadlines you will be used to setting project milestones and be responsible for keeping track of progress contributing to wider project success, and deliver software releases on time and with the expected capabilities and quality


REAL WORLD COMPETENCIES THAT MATCH OUR VALUES
• Knowledge seeker: You will have at least 3 years of Java development experience but be constantly looking to expand your knowledge in areas in and outside of your direct remit. Knowledge of front end and/or back-end Java development is crucial.

BENEFITS | WE HELP OUR PEOPLE THRIVE

Summary

Guidewire is searching for a smart, proactive, and results-oriented Software Engineer to build sophisticated solutions for the property & casualty insurance industry's complex business domain and make our industry-leading products even better. The product development team is looking for an enthusiastic engineer who is passionate about building high-quality software with a phenomenal team and improving the customer experience for millions of people who use our products every day.

You will have the opportunity to make an impact and contribute to a complex application suite of products that generate over 500 million dollars of revenue annually, mission-critical to 400+ enterprises serving more than a million users. Guidewire provides outstanding software for the second-largest financial services industry in the world: insurance. We deliver the core applications that Property and Casualty (P/C) insurers use to build their products, sell policies, settle claims, and bill their customers. The SaaS solutions delivered via Guidewire Cloud enable our customers to rapidly innovate and drive measurable value. Guidewire Cloud is powered by the highly resilient Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud infrastructure, with SLAs backed by experienced Guidewire teams and SaaS-certified partners spanning application management, system administration, security and compliance, upgrades, QA testing, health checks, and other services.

The successful candidate will work on the entire technology stack, from the core persistence layer through to the Web Application front ends.Our teams are lean, empowered, and collaborative. You must be a self-starter and able to perform independently while working alongside intelligent colleagues who've checked their egos at the door in a team environment, communicating effectively with everyone. We've built a strong culture, and we're looking for engineers who can help us maintain it.

Successful software engineers at Guidewire typically have:



- Enjoy working collaboratively in an empowered, small, cross-functional team
- Experience working in an agile and fast paced development environment (e.g. TDD, BDD, Agile, pair programming, etc.)
- A passion for code quality demonstrated by thorough testing
- A desire to be hands-on in designing and writing code
- Curiosity and internal motivation to constantly improve
- Ability to learn quickly in a dynamic environment
- Excellent communication skills, comfort level to speak their mind and defend ideas based on merit, yet humility and hunger to learn from others.

Key Qualifications Include Experience With



- 2-4 years of experience in enterprise software development
- Proficiency in Core Java and solid understanding of JavaScript / HTML5 / CSS.
- Experience with a market leading client-side framework (e.g. React, Angular) is plus.
- Familiarity with Continuous Delivery, Continuous Integration, Unit/Integration Testing, etc
- Object-Oriented Design using SOLID and Hexagonal design principles
- Experience building secure software and knowledge of security practices
- Experience working with Open-Source frameworks (e.g. Spring, Jersey, Drools, others)
- Understanding of relational database persistence (e.g. MySQL, Oracle). Familiarity with NoSQL databases (e.g. MongoDB, CouchDB) is a plus
- Agile development practices
- Experience with REST or gRPC based APIs
- Cloud Services (e.g. AWS/GCP/Azure)
- A typical candidate has a Computer Science degree or equivalent

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.

As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.
